title: Android month-cell hoisting comparison
scope: Android UI fixture paging only; not database, network, or write throughput; no FPS claim.

comparison_provenance.baseline: Accepted bounded-preview measured APKs from the prior month-cells iteration.
comparison_provenance.candidate: Shared month-cell geometry optimization evaluated in this v2 run.
comparison_provenance.causal_scope: Only contemporaneous paired v2 captures are compared. Historical readiness/council traces are contextual and are not mixed into paired or causal estimates.
comparison_provenance.display_condition: Refresh-rate overlay was enabled before this iteration; unchanged for both fresh sides. This is not app FPS and differs from previous historical captures.

evaluation_plan.scope: Android incremental shared-month optimization; Apple and 120 FPS acceptance separate
evaluation_plan.baseline: Accepted bounded-preview measured APKs from month-cells/after; final today-dot visual-only fix is not on default-height timed path
evaluation_plan.candidate: Shared geometry above pager; no further preview-density reduction
evaluation_plan.ordering: Alternating pair order and workload order; final binaries frozen before capture
controls: Identical fixture data and loading timing
No concurrent host builds during captures
evaluation_plan.tail_analysis: Report every loading frame >=40ms, rate per frame, every maximum and any recurring candidate-only >=50ms measure stall
evaluation_plan.independence: Targets are prospective review guides, not a guaranteed numerical score. Historical original-baseline comparisons are contextual, not contemporaneous causal attribution.
evaluation_plan.capture_temperature_policy: Record battery/HAL per run; compare paired temperatures and flag drift. No concurrent builds. Do not discard unfavorable captures.
evaluation_plan.display_overlay: Refresh-rate overlay was enabled before this iteration; unchanged for both fresh sides. This is not app FPS and differs from previous historical captures.

notes: Frame p95/p99/max are per-run frame durations; late-frame percentage comes from matched FrameTimeline deadlines.
PSS is one end-of-workload dumpsys meminfo snapshot per run, not a time series.
Memory PSS and main/RenderThread CPU are paired by repetition; CPU totals cover the full recorded trace.
Page-work and composable slice durations are inclusive and can overlap; nested durations are not summed across rows or composables.
Loading marker overlap reports timestamp coincidence with swipe intervals only; it makes no FPS or per-frame causality claim.
Thermal start/end states are retained as conditions; nonzero statuses should be considered when interpreting paired changes.

candidate_only_ge_50ms_stalls.interpretation: A candidate-only duration occurrence is a paired count comparison, not evidence that month-cell work caused the frame.

gesture_window_analysis.scope: Command-window plus 500 ms settling proxy; not exact gesture attribution or FPS.
notes: Frame timestamps are converted to epoch seconds using the nearest preceding REALTIME clock_snapshot offset.
Frames are selected by start time in the union of swipe command windows plus 500 ms settling; duplicates are removed with EXISTS.
Each run also retains every full-trace app surface frame >=40 ms with window, nearby marker/swipe, and owner measure/layout overlap context.
Owner measure/layout overlap is contextual timing evidence only and is not causal attribution.
Frame durations and deadline overruns are unmodified and are not clipped to window edges.
Long-frame rate is count per minute of unioned command-plus-settling exposure, not wall-clock FPS.
Metrics are FrameTimeline samples in the selected proxy windows, not FPS or precise gesture-only measures.
